name: Renata Glasc
notes: Renata opens by self-casting Bailout (W) immediately, since it has no cast time, to start its attack-speed ramp as early as possible; within the usual 8-15 s fight window it is cast only once (cooldown 24-28 s), but it recasts on cooldown if a longer fight allows it.

Handshake (Q) is cast on cooldown; its recast (the knockback) is modeled as landing right after the initial hook hit, since the hook's travel and the ~1 s tether are not modeled beyond the usual cast lockout, giving two magic-damage instances per Q cycle and the cooldown starting once both land.

Loyalty Program (E) is cast on cooldown for a single magic-damage instance: the dummy is read as being hit once by the missile's arrival (the common reading), not separately by the instant side rockets and the pass-through.

Leverage (P) procs its bonus magic damage on Renata's first attack, since the dummy starts unmarked; against one stationary target the mark only ever refreshes on later attacks and never expires, so it fires exactly once for the whole fight.

Bailout's attack-speed bonus ramps linearly from its base value at cast to double that value at 5 s elapsed (RenataW.MaxStatMultiplier=2, taken as a continuous ramp); its movement-speed bonus and ally-targeting are not modeled since movement and allies do not matter in this fight.
Hostile Takeover (R) is never cast: it deals no direct damage, and with no allied unit for a berserked dummy to redirect its attention to, casting it only spends cast time and mana for nothing.
Mana costs are not modeled: none of Q/W/E's costs would stop casting inside a 15 s fight at level 16.

unused.W: Bailout deals no direct damage of its own (its only damage-relevant mechanic in a 1v1 damage fight is the ramping attack-speed self-buff, which is cast and modeled through bonus_as and shows up as extra 'auto' source damage); its fatal-damage restore/burn mechanic never triggers here since the dummy never damages Renata.
